findings.explanation: Hardcoded literal fallback for a Facebook Page Access Token (starts with 'EAAG', matches the real FB token format/length). If FB_PAGE_TOKEN is unset, the app silently sends messages using this embedded credential instead of failing — and the token is committed in plaintext to the repo, so anyone with read access to the source can use it to act as the Page. Should be removed entirely (fail closed when env var is missing), not defaulted to a literal value.
